dependencies: physical obligations explicitly unavailable or satisfied

activation.durable_boundary: candidate manifest and prepared event commit before active pointer CAS
activation.old_client_admission: explicit version/generation matrix; unknown is denied
activation.worker_draining: stop claims, finish bounded leases, checkpoint, then fence
activation.queue_transfer: generation-tagged claims only after active pointer commit
activation.split_brain: two active generations cause immediate global write quarantine
activation.mixed_generation: read allowed only when compatible; writes quarantined
activation.partial_deployment: candidate remains PREPARED and old generation stays authoritative

rollback.trigger: typed health, integrity, security, or compatibility breach
order: restore previous active pointer by CAS
verify database, object, queue, key, provider, and local-device recovery
rollback.pending_local_work: never overwritten; reconcile by explicit manifest before any future implementation
